last_round.quote: This round was led by 500 Global in Silicon Valley, with participation from Baidu Ventures, Taiwan's AVA Angels, and our early backer MiraclePlus.

note: Founded out of a Zhejiang University thesis project as a 'Vercel for the backend' PaaS; joined MiraclePlus accelerator, then pivoted into a BYOS (Bring Your Own Server) VPS-reselling DevOps platform and later the 'Zeabur Agent' AI DevOps product. Dual-entity structure: Zeabur Inc. (Delaware, US, incorporated 2025-01-14) plus a Chinese operating entity, Hangzhou Yibo Technology Co., Ltd. The since-launched 'Zeabur AI Hub' product has been shut down per the site's own shutdown notice. No YC affiliation confirmed (visited/'met' Y Combinator-selected teams while in Silicon Valley, but is not itself a YC company).
